summary: Tech dispatch runs every 60 seconds via cron-job.org (external). vercel.json is daily-only so Vercel Hobby deploys succeed. Jarvis (Effiroad) automation runs every 10 minutes via cron-job.org, calling the new /api/jarvis/cron pipeline.

Nudge customers who never opened the pick-time link; escalate to owner
externalCrons.note: Do NOT add * * * * * for this path in vercel.json — Hobby deploys fail (see commit 69f0d15).

does: Expire unpaid Giu reservations after 15 minutes and release box inventory
Mark paid pickup holds as het_han after expiry
externalCrons.note: Giu (giucuu.com) food rescue — configure at cron-job.org alongside tech-dispatch.

does: Jarvis (자비스): source new wholesale candidates, build detail pages, queue drafts for owner review
Send exactly one SMS to the owner when new drafts were created this cycle
externalCrons.note: Effiroad (에피로드) — replaces the retired /api/cron/toss-shop-sync (see retiredCrons). 600s matches Jarvis's own design cadence (keyword rotation, API rate budget); do not lower it.

retiredCrons.reason: Old toss-shop engine, replaced end-to-end by /api/jarvis/cron. Left running, it kept building drafts from a separate old store and sending owner SMS with counts that didn't match the new pipeline ("승인 대기 2건" immediately followed by "15건") — a real incident. scripts/cron-job-org-setup.mjs disables/deletes any live cron-job.org job matching this path.

vercelCrons.note: Backup daily run; production real-time path is external 60s cron above
Daily backup; production real-time cadence is the external 600s cron-job.org job above

manualOrPostbuildCrons.note: Timeouts only (no appointment reminders). Alternative external target; NOT in vercel.json.
